name: anamnesis-automatica
description: PWA de anamnesis asistida para profesionales de salud (etapa 1: demostración con datos ficticios)

scripts.build:server: esbuild server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --packages=external --outfile=build/server.js && rm -rf build/migrations && cp -r server/real/migrations build/migrations
scripts.test:e2e: python3 .claude/skills/webapp-testing/scripts/with_server.py --server "exec env DEMO_SPEED=20 ALLOW_TEST_CLOCK=true PORT=4173 node --import tsx server/index.ts" --port 4173 -- python3 tests/e2e/run_all.py
scripts.test:e2e:voz: python3 .claude/skills/webapp-testing/scripts/with_server.py --server "exec env PORT=4174 node --import tsx tests/e2e/voice_server.ts" --port 4174 -- python3 tests/e2e/voice_flow.py
